summary.en: Chinese coast guard and navy ships gathered near Scarborough Shoal and Panatag Shoal, while the carrier Liaoning entered the western Pacific with 17 accompanying vessels, prompting alarms in Japan, Taiwan and the Philippines. The Philippine Coast Guard delivered fuel to Filipino fishermen at Scarborough Shoal as it monitored the Chinese presence, and China warned the Philippines to cease provocations and false claims. Australian defence officials warned that China’s military build up is creating pressure in the region, and tensions flared again at an ASEAN defence gathering. The conflict recorded 176 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Kystvakten og marinen fra Kina samlet seg nær Scarborough-revet og Panatag-revet, mens hangarskipet Liaoning gikk inn i vestlige Stillehavet med 17 tilhørende fartøyer, noe som utløste alarmer i Japan, Taiwan og Filippinene. Filippinsk kystvakt leverte drivstoff til filippinske fiskere ved Scarborough-revet mens den overvåket den kinesiske tilstedeværelsen, og Kina advarte Filippinene om å stoppe provokasjoner og falske påstander. Australske forsvarsmyndigheter advarte om at Kinas militære oppbygging skaper press i regionen, og spenningene blusset opp igjen på et ASEAN-forsamling for forsvar. Konflikten registrerte 176 døde i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Moro conflict
background.extract: The Moro conflict was an insurgency in the Mindanao region in southern Philippines which involved multiple armed groups. A decades-long peace process has resulted in peace deals between the Philippine government and two major armed groups, the Moro National Liberation Front (MNLF) and the Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF), but other smaller armed groups continue to exist. In 2017, the peace council settled around 138 clan conflicts.
